title: Pope Leo XIV urges European unity to fight 'lies and deceit'
subhead: On the final day of Pope Leo XIV's four-day visit to France, which has drawn crowds of French Catholics, the pontiff decried the 'increasingly uncivilized' state of international relations and urged Europe to help 'break this cycle.'

France's presidentialism crisis
subhead: The exercise of power under the 1958 Constitution has steadily eroded over the past two decades. The system has become increasingly centered on the president, to the point exhaustion, writes Le Monde's Solenn de Royer in her column.

title: India's Cockroach Party denounces crumbling schools: 'Children are treated worse than animals'
subhead: Founded just a few months ago, the Cockroach Janta Party, a Gen Z-led movement, has visited several schools and conducted an audit to expose the extent of their dilapidation and unsanitary conditions. Authorities have tried everything in their power to prevent the group from carrying out these inspections.

title: Planned Paris journalism museum launches online
subhead: Launched with UNESCO by France 24 journalist Antoine Mariotti, the News & Press Museum is planning traveling exhibitions from 2027 and a physical museum in Paris by 2029.

title: Where to live? How climate change is forcing us to rethink our relationship with our surroundings
subhead: Excessive heat, water shortages, rising sea levels: A place's habitability depends first and foremost on physical thresholds. But it also depends on the relationship between a space and the people who live there, which plays a key role in how people adapt to climate change.

The story of Paris's 'cursed' island
subhead: On October 17, a new contemporary art center, Le Large will open its doors on Seguin Island, just west of Paris. That is something of a miracle, given the many projects that have fallen through after Renault left in 1992. But the story is not over: The center of the island remains conspicuously empty.

title: How Paris, New York and Tokyo are all moving away from car-centric urban planning
subhead: In a study presented on September 9, the Paris Urban Planning Workshop analyzed how residents in seven major cities have been getting around over the past 20 years. The profound transformation of public space has given rise to new practices: residents walk, cycle and take public transport more.

title: France sending military resources to Saudi Arabia brings discreet defense ties into spotlight
subhead: By announcing the deployment of soldiers, radars, and defense systems to protect Saudi Arabia's energy infrastructure, which has been targeted by the pro-Iranian Houthi forces from Yemen, President Macron is taking a geopolitical shift at a time when Riyadh is seeking to diversify its partnerships.
